a3_missing_design_guard.reverse_conflict: must be reported missing until a separately frozen O7 hazard-looking/nominal realization is collected

fixed_model.structured_meta: three-fold StratifiedGroupKFold expert probabilities -> class-balanced logistic regression

freeze_context: Scale-v7 architecture, thresholds, splits and statistics are unchanged. This version binds the five balanced physical nuisance profiles before data.

camera_profile.fit: Go2-front calibration profiles A/B; primary views only
camera_profile.test: Go2-front calibration profile C; primary views only

material.fit: primary material prefix in {train,val}; primary views only
material.test: primary material prefix test; primary views only

scene.fit: registry split in {train,val}; all appearance views; physical-episode weights sum to one
scene.test: registry split test; primary views for headline; all views only for texture consistency

scene_and_material.fit: registry and primary material splits both in {train,val}; primary views only
scene_and_material.test: registry and primary material splits both test; primary views only

leakage_guards: no appearance view from a test physical episode enters the scene-heldout fit
material-heldout axes use primary views only so identical proprioception cannot cross the split
scene/operator/severity/appearance IDs and privileged telemetry are forbidden model inputs
appearance swaps are not independent physical samples
